body.purpose: Default running text, form inputs, table cells (15px page / 14px in forms & tables).

heading.purpose: Page titles, card/section titles, h1-h4 (weight 650, tight tracking).

label.purpose: Field labels, table column headers, stat labels — small, heavy, occasionally uppercase-tracked.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for every card, stat card, business card, table/chart card.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Highest-emphasis surface per page: the login card, and the active pill in the date-range switcher.

motion.name: ease-nav
motion.purpose: Sidebar nav-link background/color transition on hover/active.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default submit/primary-action button. Wired through the shared SubmitButton client component, which disables itself and swaps its label during a pending Server Action submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; background: #157a53; color: #ffffff; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0f6142; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.65; cursor: default; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #157a53; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action button (inline admin-form add actions, 'go to your dashboard' alternates).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #cfd4db; cursor: pointer; background: #ffffff; color: #14171f; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eef0f3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #157a53; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field used across login and every admin/owner form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #565d6b; } .ds-input { font-size: 14px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cfd4db; background: #ffffff; color: #14171f; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #157a53; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #157a53; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base raised container used for forms, stat groupings, business records, chart/table wrappers.
components.html:
Add a business

Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,23,31,0.06); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; margin-bottom: 16px; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Headline metric tile — large tabular-numeral value, small muted label, optional note.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,23,31,0.06); padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #565d6b; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #14171f; }

components.name: Accent Badge
components.description: Inline status/tag pill; also has neutral and danger tone variants.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; background: #e3f3ec; color: #0f6142; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Primary sidebar navigation item with a currentColor state-dot that only shows when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #565d6b; font-weight: 550; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #eef0f3; color: #14171f; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: #e3f3ec; color: #0f6142; } .ds-nav-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-link-active .ds-nav-dot { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Uppercase-tracked muted headers, tabular-numeral right-aligned numeric columns, row-hover fill, no border under the last row.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6ea; } .ds-table th[data-align='right'] { text-align: right; } .ds-table td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6ea; color: #14171f; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-table td[data-align='right'] { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: #eef0f3; }

components.name: Date Range Switcher
components.description: Segmented pill control for the 7/30/90-day analytics window; the one place a shadow means 'selected' rather than 'raised'.

narrative.overview: This is the category-standard SaaS dashboard, executed at full craft rather than reinvented. The owner was offered two named cultural-concept directions — a Manila wet-market "price tag" world and a "receipt ledger" world — and a competitive challenger ("Jet-Age Ticket Wallet"), and explicitly chose the plain, familiar SaaS-dashboard register instead, held to the craft bar of Oripio, a fintech-dashboard reference screenshot. The build honors that choice: a white/light-gray ground, rounded cards on a soft offset+blur shadow, one restrained green accent, and a white sidebar with a green active-nav state. Nothing here performs a theme; it reads as a professional tool a small-business owner would trust enough to pay for. Density is calm rather than enterprise-dense — generous card padding (24px), an 8-step spacing scale used consistently, and stat numbers set large enough to read at a glance. Tabular numerals appear on every count so scan totals in tables and stat cards line up predictably. No decorative device (illustration, gradient, background texture) exists anywhere in the build; the only color note allowed to stand out is the single green accent.
keyCharacteristics: Light, flat ground (#f4f5f7) with white surfaces raised on a real offset+blur shadow, never a flat glow
One accent color only (#157a53), used sparingly: active nav, primary buttons, accent badges, chart line, focus ring
Rounded-pill primary/secondary buttons and badges; large-radius (18px) cards; small-radius (8-12px) inputs and nav items
Hanken Grotesk throughout, no secondary/display typeface
Tabular numerals on every stat value and every numeric table column

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Green (#157a53/#0f6142/#e3f3ec) is the only color besides ink/neutral/danger anywhere in the UI. It marks state (active, primary action, focus) — it is never used for decoration or to differentiate content that isn't actually the primary action.

rules.name: The Numerals-Line-Up Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value that represents a count (stat cards, table scan-count columns) uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, applied globally to table and explicitly on StatCard's value. Counts must always align in a column; this is non-negotiable for a dashboard whose whole job is showing numbers at a glance.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow depth tracks a surface's role in the hierarchy (login card and active pill get shadow-md; every ordinary content card gets shadow-sm), not decoration or hover flourish. There is no hover-lift/scale animation anywhere in the build.

dos: Do keep the accent to green only (#157a53/#0f6142/#e3f3ec) — no second accent color, ever, without an explicit new direction decision.
Do use shadow-sm + Hairline border together on every card-like surface; never shadow without border or border without shadow.
Do use tabular numerals on any new numeric/count display — this is load-bearing for a scan-count dashboard.
Do route every new form submit button through the shared SubmitButton component so pending state is automatic, not something each new form has to remember.
Do keep the single 860px breakpoint as the only responsive decision point; collapse sidebar-to-top-bar rather than introducing a hamburger/off-canvas pattern.
Do cap authenticated content at 1120px max-width, matching the existing AppShell content column.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface, decorative display face, or serif — Hanken Grotesk carries the whole system by design.

Don't add gradients, background textures, illustration, or photography — none exist in the build and PRODUCT.md explicitly warns against fabricating brand assets that don't exist yet (no logo, no photography, no placeholder "trusted by" rows).
Don't use flat/glow-only shadows — the direction contract is explicit that shadows are always offset + blur.

Don't invent a themed visual concept (market/ledger/ticket motifs) on any new surface — the owner explicitly declined all three in favor of this plain register; that decision is durable per PRODUCT.md, not open by default.
